16.title: Stage 16 part 2: axonal sodium recovery dosed on the coupled geometry, with a 1 um stub coupling control, at 310 pA
16.prediction: If the threshold climb is accommodation at the initiation site read through the soma-site coupling, then on the x2 density-held geometry the first-interval threshold step grows monotonically as the axonal h_recovery_factor falls from 1.0 through 0.5, 0.25 and 0.125, and some dose reaches at least half the recorded +1.38 mV (that is +0.69 mV) while the 310 pA count stays within 5 to 15 and the spike-1 rise stays within 15 percent of the arm's own control. The same strongest dose on the default 1 um stub gives at most a fraction of that climb, because the soma cannot see the site (stage 9). Reported, not banded: the spike-5 step against the recorded +3.63 mV, the rise ratio spike 5 over spike 1 against 0.86, the fall, and the ten-element percent accuracy of the best dose beside B3's 71.8.
16.rejection: No dose reaches +0.69 mV at spike 2 (site accommodation is not the climb's mechanism; reported, not repaired); or every dose that does also leaves the count band or moves the spike-1 rise by more than 15 percent of the control (the climb is bought by crippling the cell); or the climb is not monotone in the dose (the dose is not acting through the axonal sodium's recovery); or the 1 um stub control climbs as much as the coupled arm (the coupling is not required and stage 10's account of the take-off is wrong).
16.unchanged: Every flag of the stage-10 s10-d2-density arm (axon stub 2 um, NaTs:axon 3.814, sodium density 0.9, sodium opening 2.0, kv3 closing 0.9, Ih 75x distributed, leak reversal -4 mV, SK:soma 0.35, stop 2100 ms) except the axonal h_recovery_factor; and for the coupling control the same except the stub returns to 1 um.
